name: Yorkist Household Knights
headerMeta: Heroic era · Cavalry · unique kit (mounted/dismount) · 265 leadership · Seasonal
pitch: An all-around cavalry threat that excels on flank and duels equally well mounted or dismounted. Master horse-play (Cover Commander), master ground (spell 2 into hero positioning), and never let anti-cav spike disrupt the ride — dismount only against pikemen and Stalwart.

doctrines.name: Yorkist Household Knights: Sunmirage
doctrines.note: Knight's Resolve: +20% movement speed while active

veterancy.label: Full Top
veterancy.body: Good horse play and absolute best-in-class dismounted gameplay — strong in all scenarios.

battleRole.positioning: Cavalry — play on flanks and in duel scenarios. Cover Commander is the main playstyle: stay around the commander fully until they die. {1} When flanking, toggle Cover Commander ON beforehand and confirm the red glow; it grants strong defense for 15s but X-move, spell V, or spell 1 will cancel it. {1}
battleRole.tips: On horse: spell 1 = dismount (rare now; only vs anti-cav spike), spell 2 = charge, spell 3 = follow-commander charge. In mounted 1v1, charge with spell 2 then dismount for better success. {1} On ground: absolute best-in-class — don't hesitate to dismount and press spell 2. Watch hero position closely: keep it frontline but near the unit, or the unit stops attacking and just runs. {1} Post-dismount after spell 2, enemies will rush you; don't X-move or use spell V or the 15s defense buff cancels. {1}

cards.name: Pike units (generic)
cards.why: any pikes on cav beats mounted Yorkist

matchups.pressure: You pressure: everything (Yorkist counters everything — trade depends on ground vs horse). S-tier cavalry across blur, flank, skirmish, duel.

controls.notes: Cover Commander toggle (red glow = active): stay with commander, 15s defense buff, cancelled by X/V/1. {1} Spell 2 (charge) forces overextension; activate after dismount for ground dominance. {1} Dismount (spell 1) only vs anti-cav that can disrupt or Stalwart; rare. {1}
